answer: A payout is split and therefore 41% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The velvet schedule is applied in fable and copper makes public each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3986 identities would post 1342 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
